chapters.label: Live: the 2022 Finalissima
chapters.text: The 2022 futsal Finalissima, in Buenos Aires. Spain and Portugal draw one all. Penalties! Portugal win four to two, and goalkeeper Edu celebrates.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: This is how he does it. Edu catches the shot, looks up, and throws it fast to a teammate. Counter!

chapters.label: Replay: find the free player
chapters.text: Again, slowly. One teammate is marked, but this one is free. Edu throws it flat, in front of him, so he never stops running. Two against one!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Try it with a friend. After a save, throw it fast to a free teammate to start a counter!
